title: The banner, as weather
logline: Tuesday. The ringtone banner across the top of the site, drawn as a weather front: a bright bank of cloud over every panel, the way rain sits over the bay. Nobody in the strip looks up.

panels.composition: Gully's. The top fifth of the panel: a bright, blank, glowing bank — the banner, as weather. Below it, ordinary: GULLY, WOOD (full size now), BARNABY.
props: a bright bank across the top

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a bait-shop counter scene with a bright blank glowing band across the top fifth of the panel like a bank of cloud, two men and a dog beneath it not looking up
image.notes: The banner as weather: a glowing blank strip across the top of every panel this week. Draw it like cloud, not like an ad.

panels.composition: The dock. The bright bank over the bay, where the rain would be. Wood on the steps.
props: the bright bank over the bay

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dock and bay with a bright glowing band across the top of the panel in place of cloud, a thin man on shack steps beneath

panels.composition: The garage. The bank over the drafting table. Wood drawing under it as under a lamp.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man drawing at a garage table beneath a bright glowing band across the top of the panel

panels.composition: Gully's again. Gully looking up, once — the only one who does. Then back to the counter.

balloons.text: Eight hundred a month of bright.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron glancing up at a bright glowing band across the top of the panel while a thin man on a stool does not
